text.short: Boise, in the Pioneer Building on West Main. The Ansotegui family's chorizo counter, and a lunch bar beside it.
text.today: Tuesday to Saturday, ten to three, with evenings by reservation. Chorizo at $10 a pound, small hot plates $9 to $20, a dozen uncooked croquetas $11.
text.history: The Ansoteguis put down roots in Idaho in the early 1900s. Dan Ansotegui opened Bar Gernika in 1991 and The Basque Market in 1999 before this one. Dan, Tamara and Ellie run it.
text.table: Chorizos, marinated solomo, Basque bacon over the counter; croquetas, patatas bravas, seafood and meatballs at the bar, with Basque wine and cider.
text.note: Three of the doors in this directory were opened by the same man.

seating.note: A lunch counter, plus a banquet room called Ondoan for up to 24, and evenings by reservation.

picon.note: The list names Basque wine and cider.
